contentPattern.summary: One item row per slide; each row has two cells: image | rich text. Slides are stacked in a coverflow stage: the active slide is centered and full size, neighbours are scaled down behind it. Paragraphs without links in the text cell are shown as a caption above the stage for the active slide. Optional leading rows without an image become an intro (heading).

cells: rich text: heading/title, optional caption paragraph, CTA link (button)

usage: Centered coverflow carousel with autoplay, dot indicators and a pause/play toggle: speaker portraits with name button, video teasers (Assista), product tiles (Saiba mais), plan cards with a price title.
reuseGuidance: Use when one tall card is centered and side cards peek behind it, with auto-advance. Options: image-dark (equal-size product tiles staggered vertically with title + chevron link at the bottom), image-dark-2 (centered title over darkened image, plan picker). For left-aligned scrolling cards use carousel-blog; for widening panels use carousel-expanding.
